caseno: Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 448 of 2011
lawyer:
Khurshid Alam Khan, Advocate instructed by Md. Abu Siddique, Advocate-on-Record ----- For the Petitioner 
Respondent ------ Not represented.
parties:
Arifur Rahman ------- Petitioner
Vs.
The State represented by the Deputy Commissioner, Noakhali ------- Respondent
full_judgment: 8. Victim Josna Begum @ Beauty met her this unnatural death at her husband's house So the husband is to explain as to how his wife met this unnatural death But the explanation which the accused husband gave as to her wife's death at his house has been proved false. In the circumstances the legal presumption is that the accused husband caused this death of the victim Josna Begum by throttling The accused husband though tried to say that he was not present at his house at the time of murder of his wife but this plea is not acceptable at all in view of the facts and circumstances including the fact that the accused pleaded a false case that his wife committed suicide by setting fire to her body Admittedly the accused Arifur Rahman was at his house in the previous night of the occurrence and also in the early morning of the day of occurrence. The accused has pleaded that he went out of the house in the morning of the occurrence and the death of his wife was caused while he was not at the house. But this defence plea also is not acceptable at all In view of the fact that this accused gave a false explanation as to the death of his wife. This fact that this accused gave a false explanation as to death of his wife, rather, strongly tells in favour of guilt of this accused.
